text: /vitafeed buy-in v2: qualify RED low ≤3% of peak-trough + predicted up + negative vs peak. Per injection leave behind AI $0.10 + human $0.10 + lottery $0.05 (≥$0.25) + 1.5% savings tax on whole inject-time cost (transmission/chars + piggies + gwei + other + hidden). Seat pick: deepest red first, then fewest prior trades; each injection a different token. Exit same % into the green as the dip plus cost overlay ASAP when revenue prints — leave piggies+tax parked. No qualifying seat → still inscribe (message-first). Does not change live-trader piggy-bank.js or vitaSave mother brain.

hypothesis.note: More injections = more micro wins across different red bottoms with baked leftover piggies+lottery+tax.
